newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian centre-right bloc ready to oppose budget.
newsitem.headline: Italian centre-right bloc ready to oppose budget.

text.p: The opposition centre-right Freedom Alliance will reject the government's 1997 budget, party leaders fron the political bloc told reporters after a meeting.

"We are all agreed about this. The budget is not good," Gianfranco Fini, head of the hard-right National Alliance (AN), told reporters after the summit in the house of Freedom Alliance leader, Silvio Berlusconi.
The centre-left government has not yet presented the budget package and is struggling to convince the hard-left Communist Refoundation to accept cuts in health spending and pensions.

The Treasury is also considering introducing a special "solidarity tax" to help boost finances and pull Italy closer to meeting tough criteria for countries wishing to joined planned European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU).
Prime Minister Romano Prodi is due to meet government allies at 1600 GMT later today to discuss the budget which has to be presented by the end of the week. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
